objective: LungVision AI — Post-Correction 3D CT Geometry Verification: Rigorously audit CT source volume, segmentation mask, Euler characteristic (-10), mesh orientation, mesh vs voxel volume discrepancy (0.10%), 12 LUNA16 nodule coordinates, and anatomical plausibility.
acceptance_criteria: Task 1: Verify source volume and segmentation (Scan UID, dimensions, axis order, origin, direction cosines, spacing, label voxel counts, cropped vs complete anatomy, volume reconciliation for 82.3 mL).
Task 2: Euler characteristic investigation (Dissect Euler -10 across left lung, right lung, trachea, heart; compute V, E, F, boundary edges, non-manifold edges, genus, handles, cavities).
Task 3: Mesh orientation and winding (Verify outward normals, face winding, signed volume, watertightness, degenerate faces via independent method).
Task 4: Mesh versus voxel agreement (Audit 0.10% formula, coordinate system, spacing, divergence theorem vs voxel count).
Task 5: Nodule coordinate validation (Audit all 12 LUNA16 annotations: UID, LPS/RAS, voxel conversion, spacing, Three.js transform, distance to nearest mesh surface).
Task 6: Anatomical quality (Evaluate complete segmented lung structures, orientation, cropping, airways, visual plausibility vs quantitative truth).
Task 7: Correct status reporting (Provide granular statuses: Segmentation integrity, Coordinate integrity, Mesh topology, Mesh orientation, Volume agreement, Nodule mapping, Anatomical completeness).
Deliverables: Author POST_FIX_CT_GEOMETRY_AUDIT.md, CT_VOLUME_RECONCILIATION.json, MESH_TOPOLOGY_AUDIT.json, NODULE_COORDINATE_VALIDATION.json, CT_GEOMETRY_TEST_REPORT.md.
non_goals: Do not delete existing models, checkpoints, masks, or research assets
Do not artificially force Euler characteristic to 4 or invent data
Do not modify voxel spacing to fabricate volume
Do not begin Phase 2B SSM integration until underlying CT geometry is verified
